description: This file manages IRC account configurations, including parsing environment variables, resolving passwords, and listing enabled IRC accounts within a larger application.

methods.name: parseTruthy
methods.description: Converts a string value to a boolean based on predefined truthy values.

methods.name: parseIntEnv
methods.description: Parses an environment variable string into a positive integer port number.

methods.name: mergeIrcAccountConfig
methods.description: Merges core configuration with account-specific settings for IRC.

methods.name: resolvePassword
methods.description: Resolves the password for an IRC account from environment, file, or config.

methods.name: resolveNickServConfig
methods.description: Resolves the NickServ configuration for an IRC account, including password and registration email.

methods.name: resolveIrcAccount
methods.description: Resolves a complete IRC account configuration, including environment variables and defaults.

methods.name: listEnabledIrcAccounts
methods.description: Lists all enabled IRC accounts based on current configuration.
